@font-face{font-family:"Bike Clássica";src:url("data:font/ttf;base64,") format("truetype");font-display:block;}

.compact-model-picker{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr) auto minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:8px!important;max-width:864px!important;padding:12px 15px!important;align-items:center!important}
.compact-model-picker .color-label{margin-left:0!important}
.compact-model-picker select{width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;min-width:0!important;flex:none!important;font-size:13px!important;padding:9px 5px!important}
.compact-model-picker label{font-size:13px!important}
.sheet[data-font="esportiva"] .hero-title{font-family:"Bike Esportiva",sans-serif!important}
.sheet[data-font="caligrafia"] .hero-title{font-family:"Bike Caligrafia",cursive!important}
.sheet[data-font="impacto"] .hero-title{font-family:"Bike Impacto",sans-serif!important}
.sheet[data-font="dinamica"] .hero-title{font-family:"Bike Dinâmica",sans-serif!important}
.sheet[data-font="classica"] .hero-title{font-family:"Bike Clássica",sans-serif!important}
.sheet[data-font] .hero-title{font-style:normal!important;font-weight:normal!important;transform:none!important;letter-spacing:-.035em!important;line-height:.96!important;font-size:6.75cqw!important}
@media(max-width:480px){.compact-model-picker{gap:5px!important;padding:9px 7px!important}.compact-model-picker label{font-size:11px!important}.compact-model-picker select{font-size:11px!important;padding:8px 2px!important}}

.sheet[data-font="grafite"] .hero-title{font-family:"Pop grafite"!important;font-size:6.4cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:1.02!important}
